Bldgs.6& 7 PARTY WALL DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS, made as of this 15th day of July, 2002, by Landmark Projects IV, Inc., having offices at 250 Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10003 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer") and NYC Partnership Housing Development Fund Company, Inc., having offices at One Battery Park Plaza, New York, New York 10004, (hereinafter referred to as the “NYCP") (Developer and NYCP are hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, NYCP is the owner of the real property in borough of Manhattan as described onSchedule“A"Block1928Lot7and Block1928Lot 107,New York,NY, annexed hereto and made a part hereof, upon which Developer intends to build two new three family-four story townhouses; WHEREAS, the Developer has built two residential buildings in such a manner that eachof thebuildings shall adjoin the other and shall beconnectedtoeach otherby a commonParty Wall ("Party Wall"); WHEREAS the Declarants desire to declare the following restrictions, covenants and agreements governing said Party Wall; and WHEREAS,thehome designated asBlock1928Lot7islocated at street address 269 West 122nd Street, New York, N.Y.and the home on the other side of the Party Wall is designated as Block 1928 Lot 107 and is located at street address 267 West 123rd Street, New York, NY; NOW THEREFORE, the following declaration of restrictions, covenants and agreements shall run with the land and be binding upon the Declarants herein, their heirs, owner of Block 1928 Lot 7 and of Block 1928 Lot 107, New York,N.Y. and the heirs, successors and assigns of each such subsequent owner. 1. ThePartyWall was constructed in such afashion as tobe located an equal distance on or over the respective adjoining lots with the midline of the Party Wall being located as nearly as possible on the common boundary line and it is understood that minor variations may be present due to topographical problems or construction requirements. 2. The PartyWall shall be used and maintained as a PartyWall forever and the owner of the lot on each side of thePartyWall,shall belicensed and permittedto enter upon the premises of the owner on the other side of the Party Wall to make intentions to do so. Furthermore, a representative of the owner of the premises to be entered must bepresentwhenever the owner or representatives of the owner on

Bldgs.6&7 the other side of the Party Wall enters such premises,pursuant to this Declaration of Restrictions. 3. On the owner's side, said owner may at any time add to the Party Wall in depth or must be consented to by the owners on both sides of the Party Wall.In no event shall anyextension of thePartyWall,interferewith,orimpair theuseof theParty Wall, nor shall any such addition interfere with, or impair the use of the Party Wall by the other owner, nor shall any such extension of thePartyWall interfere with the use or enjoyment of the townhouse belonging to the adjoining owner. 4. If thePartyWall is at any time extended,the cost of such extension shall bepaid by the owner making such extension. In the event thePartyWall shall be damaged or destroyed by fire or other casualty, the owners on each side of the Party Wall agree to reconstruct the Party Wall as provided herein with respect to use, location and construction; each owner agrees to apply the funds received from any insurance carrier, or third party who may be responsible for the damage to the Party Wall, toward the reconstruction of the Party Wall. 6.  In the event of the making of any repairs to or rebuilding of said Party Wall or any addition or change thereto, the owner so doing shall make such repairs or rebuild or add toor extend saidPartyWall in such away as to leave the owner on the other side of the Party Wall as nearly as is reasonably possible under the circumstances, in the same condition with respect to saidPartyWall as before and shall use good material throughout and do such work in a good, substantial and workmanlike manner. Such owner so repairing or rebuilding or extending shall do all work in connection therewith, as far as is reasonably possible from his own side of the division line and shall do all work in conformance with the requirements of the Building Laws of the State and City of New York and the rules, regulations and ordinances of any governmental authority having jurisdiction thereof. 7. Party Wall as constructed, the cost of such repairing and/or such rebuilding, as to such portions of the Party Wall used by both owners, shall be borne equally by both owners. 8. If and when the Party Wall is rebuilt it shall stand upon the same place and be of the same or similar materials and of the same proportions as thePartyWall described above. 9. No director,member,officer or employee of the Declarants shall be personally liable under or by reason of this Declaration of Restrictions, nor shall any director, member, officer or employee be sued individually for damages by reason of a breachof thisDeclaration of Restrictions.

Bldgs.6&7 10.Nothing herein contained shall obligate or make responsible or liable in any way in for the owner's acts ofomission and commissionwhileowner. 11. This Declaration of Restrictions shallremain ineffect solong as one of the townhousesshallremainstanding.In theeventbothtownhouses aredemolished or destroyed, then, and in such event, this Declaration of Restrictions shall automatically terminate,but nothing contained in this Declaration of Restrictions shall prevent the owners from negotiating and entering into a Party Wall Declaration of Restrictions.
